title: SG-8.3 Submit button disabled and loading states with inline success feedback
summary: Contribution Send button is disabled when invalid, empty, quota-exhausted or in flight, shows a loading label, and the sheet shows inline success as well as error feedback.
description: Context: ContributionSheet (game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx) currently disables Send only when remaining <= 0 (L129). Blank and over-limit text leave it enabled, there is no in-flight guard, and the button label never changes. Success is shown only as a per-entry 'Sent' label in the list; errors show in a role=alert paragraph. Desired behavior: Send is disabled for blank, over-limit, zero quota and in-flight submissions, shows a loading label while in flight, and an inline success message appears after a successful send alongside the existing error message. Why: players get immediate, unambiguous feedback and cannot double-submit.
acceptance_criteria: Given blank or whitespace-only text, over-limit text, zero remaining quota, or a submission in flight, when the sheet renders, then the Send button is disabled.
Given a submission in flight, when the sheet renders, then the button label reads 'Sending…' and returns to 'Send' when the request settles.
Given a successful submission, when it resolves, then an inline role=status message 'Suggestion sent' is shown and a failed submission still shows the existing role=alert error.

in_scope: ContributionSheet Send button disabled and loading states
preserve: Existing handleSubmit guards and validation messages
API contract of submitContribution and listMine

technical_constraints: Frontend only: React + TypeScript in game/frontend
definition_of_done: All three requirements are implemented and their unit tests pass
non_functional: Disabled and status states are announced accessibly (disabled attribute, role=status)
